title: APD investigates overnight shooting on Second Avenue
summary: Detectives are canvassing the 200 block of Second Avenue after a shooting left one person wounded. No arrest has been announced.

title: Suspect arraigned in Colonie armed robbery of Wolf Road retailer
summary: A 24-year-old was arraigned in Colonie Town Court after a weekend robbery. Bail arguments continue.

title: Bethlehem crews knock down two-alarm fire on Delaware Avenue
summary: Volunteer companies stopped the fire before it spread to exposures. Cause under investigation.

title: Albany Common Council hears public-safety camera expansion plan
summary: The mayor's office briefed council members on adding cameras along Central Avenue and South Pearl Street.

title: Troop G and ACSO announce Guilderland trafficking arrest
summary: A joint investigation led to felony narcotics charges after a traffic stop on Route 20.

title: I-787 crash in Menands snarls evening commute
summary: A multi-vehicle collision closed northbound lanes for two hours. Injuries were reported as non-life-threatening.

title: Weekend blotter: Cohoes and Watervliet report rise in catalytic converter thefts
summary: Both departments asked residents to report suspicious activity in driveway-facing alleys.

title: FBI Albany Field Office warns of tax-season wire fraud spike
summary: Business email compromise losses in the Capital Region are tracking above last spring, the bureau said.

title: UAlbany PD: no ongoing threat after unfounded shots-fired call
summary: Officers cleared academic buildings after a 911 call that could not be corroborated.

title: DCJS quarterly: Albany County index crime down vs. 2024
summary: Property crime drove the decline; violent crime was roughly flat county-wide.
